title: Decide an Expense Status
prompt: Given an amount, category, and receipt flag, calculate named Boolean facts and use when to produce Blocked, Receipt required, or Ready.
successCriteria: Independent rules have descriptive Boolean names.
Invalid input is checked before broader approval rules.
Exactly one status is produced for every input combination.
hints: Start with canSubmit and needsReceipt facts.
The first matching when branch wins.
solutionOutline: Define the validation and receipt facts.
Order the when branches from blocking to general.
verification: Try a negative amount, blank category, and missing receipt.
Record why each input reaches its branch.
